title: Classic raid augments
summary: Level-50 chest augments from dragons and the planes.
body:
Level-50 raid augments share one type-22 socket on chest armor. Each is individually LORE. You can collect different trophies and wear one at a time. Each boss makes one independent roll for the corpse. Managed runs require Raid objective credit.

EncounterAugmentChanceBenefit
Lady VoxFrostbound Pearl25%+8 Healing Amount, +4 heroic WIS, +10 cold resist
Lord NagafenCinderfang25%+8 Spell Damage, +4 ATK, +10 fire resist
Phinigel AutroposDeepwater Pearl15%+4 Healing Amount, +4 Spell Damage, +10 cold resist
Master YaelUnderfoot Sliver15%+6 AC, +40 HP, +10 magic resist
Dread, Fright or TerrorDreadbone15%+4 heroic STA, +3 Avoidance, +8 disease resist
a dracolicheHollow Fang15%+4 heroic STR, +4 Accuracy, +8 disease resist
Hand of the Maestro or Maestro of RancorShard of Discord15%+6 ATK, +4 Spell Damage, +2 Accuracy
Magi P`TasaAshen Sigil15%+6 Spell Damage, +3 heroic INT, +20 mana
a thunder spirit princess or Protector of SkyClouded Opal15%+2 Avoidance, +25 HP, +8 magic resist
Gorgalosk or Keeper of SoulsSoulglass15%+4 Healing Amount, +3 heroic WIS, +20 mana
The Spiroc Guardian, The Spiroc Lord or Sister of the SpireCloudglass Lens15%+4 heroic DEX, +4 Accuracy, +8 magic resist
Bazzt ZzztAmber Wing15%+3 heroic DEX, +4 ATK, +8 poison resist
Noble Dojorn, Overseer of Air or the Hand of VeeshanEfreeti Opal15%+4 Spell Damage, +4 Accuracy, +8 magic resist
Cazic-ThuleFaceless Aegis50%When a direct hostile hit leaves you alive below 35% HP, gain a 120-point rune for up to 12 seconds.
InnoruukHeart of Spite50%A direct melee, ranged or gem spell hit restores up to 90 missing HP.
Eye of VeeshanPrism of the Eighth Isle50%Spend 10% of maximum mana or endurance in combat to recover 1% of that pool, up to 50 points.

The three final-boss effects share at least 90 seconds of reuse across swaps, zoning and relogging. The server checks whole seconds, so reuse can take up to 91 seconds. Only eligible Hunt augments raise the special Spell Damage or Healing Amount cap. The Hand of Veeshan belongs to the public efreeti chain. The Eye is the Sky Raid finale. Master Yael’s public spawn route still needs confirmation.
